subject: Weekly revenue roll-up prep + submission & sync

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly revenue roll-up prep + submission & sync

Team —

Quick heads-up for this week’s revenue roll-up: finance needs the finalized submission by EOD Wednesday so FP&A can ingest into the model before Friday’s review. Please use the attached weekly_submission_template.csv and the pipeline snapshot I pulled (Q2_pipeline_snapshot.xlsx) as the source of truth.

Action items (please complete before the sync at 10:30 PT):
- Update your deals in the template: stage, commit probability, expected close date, ARR delta, and any gating notes.
- Flag deals that need reclassification (e.g., move from POC to Commit) with a one-line rationale.
- Upload your completed template to the shared drive link and paste the HubSpot deal link in the "source_link" column.

Agenda for 10:30 PT sync (30m):
1) Rapid roll-up: top 10 deals by ARR (5m)
2) High-risk deals & ask list (10m)
3) Movement requests / stage changes (10m)
4) Submission checklist & final owner (5m)

Meeting: Zoom (link below) — aim to be concise; PMs and Finance reps will jump in only for blockers.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210
Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aB2C3D4E5/view
HubSpot deal sample: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
